name: Email (IMAP, read-only)
description: Persona and skill for reading an email mailbox over IMAP. Provides read-only tools (native, because IMAP is not HTTP) to list mailboxes, search mail, list recent mail, and fetch a full message. Every session uses IMAP EXAMINE, so the mailbox is never modified (no marking read, no deletes). Works with any IMAP provider (Gmail, Fastmail, Zoho, self-hosted). Authenticated by IMAP_HOST, IMAP_USER, and IMAP_PASSWORD (an App Password for Gmail); optional IMAP_PORT (default 993).
